name: CADCraft
description: Headless 2D CAD drafting app (CADCraft from ArtCraft, open source, written in Rust) with an AutoCAD-style command line. Draws floor plans and technical drawings — lines, polylines, rectangles, arcs, hatches, text, dimensions, leaders, layers and blocks — through 450+ commands and .scr scripts, opens and saves DXF and DWG, renders PNG previews and exports PDF and SVG. 2D drafting only, not 3D parametric modeling: for 3D parts use solidcraft.
instructions:
CADCraft runs headless in your own container; every file lives in /work.

1. Start a drawing. For a new one: new_drawing {"metric":true} (units are millimetres; draw a room of 4 × 5 m as 4000 × 5000). To edit the user's drawing, upload it to /work and open it: open {"path":"/work/in.dxf"} (DXF or DWG).
2. Draw with AutoCAD commands, y goes up. command_line {"text":"circle 0,0 500"} types one line (spaces act as Enter); script {"text":"..."} runs several lines like a .scr file. Set the dimension scale first so that dimension text and arrows are readable at the drawing's size (dimscale 50 for a room in mm), e.g. script {"text":"dimscale 50\nrectang 0,0 4000,5000\ndimlinear 0,0 4000,0 2000,-600\ndimlinear 4000,0 4000,5000 4600,2500\nzoom e\n"}. Points are x,y, relative @dx,dy, polar @dist<angle. When a command waits for more input, the answer shows its prompt; cancel {} aborts it.
3. Everything else: list_commands {"filter":"dim"} (also "layer", "hatch", "text", "block", "offset"…) — always pass a filter, the registry has hundreds of commands — then execute {"command":"layer.new","params":{"name":"Walls","color":"red","current":true}} with the params it lists.
4. Check the result: inspect_drawing {} (entity counts, extents, layers) and query_entities {"type":"Dimension"}; render {"background":"white"} saves a PNG preview into /work and returns its path (no inline image) — download it to look at it or to show it.
5. Save and export: save {"path":"/work/plan.dxf"}; the extension picks the format: .dxf, .dwg (both DXF/DWG 2018), .pdf, .svg, .png. For a PDF on a paper size use execute {"command":"plot","params":{"path":"/work/plan-a4.pdf","paper":"ISO A4 (210.00 x 297.00 MM)","fit":true}} (list_commands {"filter":"plot"} shows the options). Use a new file name for every export.
6. Hand the result over: download it from /work with plugin_download_file.

All paths must be inside /work; relative paths resolve against /work. File commands take their path as JSON (save, open, or execute with params.path), not typed at the command line. A new MCP session (e.g. after a reconnect) starts with an empty drawing, so save a .dxf or .dwg after each stage and open it then. The container and /work are deleted after the conversation is idle, so always download the results.

accepts.description: DXF drawing to edit (ASCII or binary)

returns.description: Rendered drawing or render preview PNG
